Section 1.Title: STANDARDS
Items: THE PCB SHALL BE FABRICATED IN ACCORDANCE WITH THE CURRENT REVISION OF ${fab_standard}.
INTERPRET DIMENSIONS AND TOLERANCES IN ACCORDANCE WITH THE CURRENT REVISION OF ASME Y14.5M.
TEST IN ACCORDANCE WITH THE CURRENT REVISION OF IPC-TM-650 2.4.22.
DO NOT SCALE TO DRAWING.

Section 2.Title: MATERIAL
Items: THE PCB DIELECTRIC MATERIAL SHALL BE ${material}.
THICKNESSES OF CONDUCTOR AND DIELECTRIC SHALL MATCH THE STACKUP DRAWING.

Section 3.Title: FLATNESS
Items: BOW AND TWIST OF ASSEMBLY SUB-PANEL OR SINGULATED PWB SHALL NOT EXCEED 0.75%.
TEST IN ACCORDANCE WITH CURRENT REVISION OF IPC-TM-650 2.4.22.

Section 4.Title: ETCH GEOMETRY.
Items: MEASURE WIDTH FROM THE BASE OF THE METALLIZATION.
FINISHED LINE WIDTH AND TERMINAL AREA SHALL NOT DEVIATE FROM THE GERBER PATTERN IMAGE BY MORE THAN 20%.

Section 5.Title: SURFACE FINISH
Items: ${surface_finish} - EXPOSED METAL SHALL HAVE COMPLETE SOLDER COVERAGE.

Section 6.Title: HOLES
Items: SEE HOLE TABLE FOR DIMENSIONS (AFTER PLATING WHERE APPLICABLE).
PLATING IN HOLES SHALL BE CONTINUOUS ELECTROLYTIC COPPER IN ACCORDANCE WITH IPC-6012, CLASS 2.
SEE DRILL CHART FOR FINISHED HOLE SIZE AND PLATING.
ALL HOLES SHALL BE LOCATED WITHING 3 MIL OF TRUE POSITION AS SUPPLIED IN CAD DATA.

Section 7.Title: SOLDERMASK
Items: SOLDERMASK OVER BARE COPPER (SMOBC) ON PRIMARY AND SECONDARY SIDES USING SUPPLIED ARTWORK IN ACCORDANCE WITH CURRENT REVISION OF IPC-SM-840 TYPE B.
COLOR: ${soldermask_color}.
LIQUID PHOTO-IMAGEABLE (LPI) 0.001 INCH TO 0.002 INCH THICKNESS, HALOGEN FREE.
NO BLEED-OUT ALLOWED OVER EXPOSED SMD PADS.

Section 8.Title: SILKSCREEN
Items: SILKSCREEN PRIMARY AND SECONDARY SIDE WITH NON-CONDUCTIVE, NON-NUTRIENT EPOXY INK.
COLOR: ${silkscreen_color}.
ANY UNSPECIFIED STROKE WIDTH SHALL BE 5 MIL.
CLIP SILKSCREEN AWAY FROM ANY EXPOSED METAL.

Section 9.Title: FINISHING
Items: REMOVE ALL BURRS AND BREAK SHARP EDGES.

Section 10.Title: PANELIZED PWBS LAYOUT
Items: IF THE PWB IS PANELIZED, THE VENDOR HAS THE FREEDOM TO MOVE INDIVIDUAL OR GROUPED PWBS TO ANY LOCATION ON THE PANEL TO EASE FABRICATION OR TEST.

Section 11.Title: NET TIES AND SHORTS
Items: CONSULT THE NET TIE SHORTS TABLE FOR NETS THAT ARE INTENTIONALLY SHORTED WITH NET TIES.

Section 12.Title: NON-DESTRUCTIVE EVALUATION
Items: ALL PWBS SHALL PASS 100% ELECTRICAL TEST USING SUPPLIED IPC-D-365 NETLIST IN ACCORDANCE WITH CURRENT REVISION OF IPC-9252, CLASS 2.
CERTIFICATE OF CONFORMANCE SHALL BE SUPPLIED WITH EACH SHIPMENT.
IF A NETLIST IS NOT PROVIDED, AN INFERRED NETLIST FROM GERBER DATA IS A PERMISSIBLE SUBSTITUTE.
